CREATE TRIGGER "trg_purchaseOrder_status_transition_guard" BEFORE UPDATE OF "status" ON "purchaseOrder" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."status" IS NOT OLD."status" AND (
  OLD."status" IN ('shipped')
  OR NOT COALESCE(
    (OLD."status" IS NULL AND NEW."status" IN ('placed'))
    OR (OLD."status" IS 'placed' AND NEW."status" IN ('shipped')), 0))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'purchaseOrder.status cannot make this move: its state machine does not list it');
END
steps.subject: trigger/purchaseOrder/trg_purchaseOrder_status_transition_guard
